findings.finding: [native] The Direct Packages group header is drawn expanded (chevron down) with a count badge of 2, yet no row and no message leaf follow it before the Transitive Packages separator. A VS Code tree never shows an expanded node with a count and nothing under it. While the @vulnerable filter is active, DS-COPY-5 expects the count as 'N of M' text (here '0 of 2'), not the unfiltered badge used in the artboard's project headers (e.g. Unresolved.csproj '2' heading two rows). | [geometry] The Direct Packages group header is drawn expanded (down chevron) with a count badge of 2, but nothing follows it before the separator and the Transitive Packages header (y 215 to 219): no package rows and no message leaf. The artboard always puts content under an expanded group: rows, or for an empty group a message leaf at the title column, as in Empty.csproj's "No packages installed." at x 36. So the group's body is missing and its count contradicts the empty list. | [states] Under the active @vulnerable filter the expanded Direct Packages group header shows a plain count badge "2" with no rows beneath it, so the header claims two packages the filtered list does not show; while filtering the count should read in the "N of M" form ("0 of 2"), not as the unfiltered total.
findings.reason: The form the design-advisor opening ruling of 2026-11-21 ordered: DO 6c (under @vulnerable with an unknown part the banner stands alone, never an empty sentence beside it) and DO 6e (a group with an unknown entry keeps its total N); DS-COPY-5 forbids a badge and "(N)" together and its hard line is green (headers 2: count badges 1, "(N)" texts 0); a single project's sentence sits above the tree, never in it (gotcha "A message inside a grouped list"); DECISIONS 2026-11-21 "Unknown vulnerability data in the Installed tab (UX-P5.1a)". Design-advisor follow-up 2 of 2026-11-21, docs/plans/handoff/P5.1a.md.

refuted.reason: The crop shows the capture's placeholder "Search or type @ to filter" and the artboard's older "Search packages, or filter: @...", but the capture follows the copy that design-system.md's main-header overflow row sets (since UX-P3.fix-15). The hard measurement confirms that copy fits: DS-OVERFLOW-2@main-installed-cpm/placeholder reads "Search or type @ to filter" 164 of 1136 px. The redline's spec.json says nothing about the placeholder, so this is not a §6 artboard-versus-spec conflict and there is no visible defect in the capture itself.
